property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, the correct contract calls transferFrom on all indices 0..length-1 (no revert), while the buggy version skips the last element, so if any later observer can detect incomplete transfers the bug is revealed; here we assert that after transfer returns, for all i, the calls were attempted, which is true for correct but false for bug when _tos.length > 1 because the last recipient was never called.
change_summary: Replace 'for(uint i=0; i<_tos.length; i++)' with 'for(uint i=0; i<_tos.length-1; i++)' to skip the last transfer.
